# Nicolas Lekai — AI Systems Architect

> Independent, vendor-neutral AI systems architect. Builds one custom operating system that runs every AI tool a company pays for, in one window with one login. Munich and London. The same person also works as a director for film, VFX and post-production at nicolaslekai.com.

## What this is

Most companies already pay for a dozen good AI and production products that do not talk to each other. Nicolas Lekai wires them into a single bespoke operating system: one login, one interface, the company's own data. The team never has to open the underlying tools — agents in the system drive them.

## Services

- Custom systems — bespoke operating systems and control centres, plus internal tools shaped around how a team already works
- Production pipelines — AI image and video pipelines wired into real post-production, built by filmmakers and CGI artists with over 25 years of experience
- Strategy and training — audits, roadmaps and build-vs-buy calls with real numbers; hands-on training at the desk, role by role

## Cost control

The system meters every AI service call as it happens (image, video, language, voice) and enforces hard budget caps per tool, per project and per month. All providers appear in one view, with one running total.

## Long-term memory

The system keeps a long-term memory of the company: projects, decisions and preferences. It learns how the company works and gets sharper the longer it runs, starting with one department and scaling from there.

## How the work runs

- Phase 01, audit (about 5 days) — mapping the real workflows with the teams, ending in a written brief with the hours and the costs in it
- Phase 02, build (about 4 to 8 weeks) — the highest-value systems built in the company's own stack, shipped in weekly increments the client can veto
- Phase 03, embed (ongoing) — training the people, documenting everything, then stepping back; optional retainer as models change

## Tools under the hood

Claude, GPT, Gemini, Kimi, Llama, Mistral, Whisper, ElevenLabs, ComfyUI, Flora, Higgsfield, Flux, Kling, Veo, Midjourney, DaVinci Resolve, Nuke, Houdini, Blender, Unreal, After Effects, Photoshop, Figma, Notion, Slack, WhatsApp, Gmail, Drive, Dropbox, Sheets, HubSpot, Stripe, GitHub.

## Position

Off-the-shelf AI makes every company equally average. These systems are built around the way a specific company works, so they cannot simply be subscribed to by a competitor. Nothing is resold: if the right answer is a small subscription rather than a platform migration, that is the recommendation. Scopes are fixed, demos weekly, and every initiative has kill criteria.
